facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's Plan stratégique de la santé numérique 2025-2029, dated January 2025 and drawn up by its Direction des systèmes d'information, names Endos-BF among the solutions already deployed and carries an axis on modernising the health information system; it is costed at 42,576,806,267 FCFA, against 2,762,824,725 FCFA of available funds and a financing gap of 39,813,981,543 FCFA.

The Ministry of Health's strategy lists, among innovations in the health system, the scaling-up of decentralised entry of routine data in health facilities; it gives no count of facilities and no date, so the document's date is used, and it does not name the system in that sentence.

note: No EMR fact: the plan describes no patient record for general care in use; its 2023 environment survey found 124 applications, 76% of those for health professionals being isolated single-disease patient follow-up tools, and the computerised patient record (dossier patient informatisé) among the needs most expressed; the 2016-2020 e-health strategy, which included integrated hospital systems, was not implemented. Other context: 65% of basic health facilities had internet access and 6.27% of structures were on RESINA (2023); partners funded 81.67% of computer equipment. Tier names: CSPS and centres médicaux (first échelon), CMA (district referral), CHR/CHUR, CHU. The file ends mid-sentence in Part IV; the annexes are not in it.
